actions.addTarget.description: Add a new target to your Intruder account
actions.addTarget.props.address.descript: The address or domain of the target (e.g., example.com, 192.168.1.1)
actions.addTarget.props.tags.description: Tags to organize and filter targets
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.searchForATarget.props.address.d: The address or domain to search for (e.g., example.com, 192.168.1.1)
actions.searchForAnIssue.description: Search for issues with optional filters
actions.searchForAnIssueOccurrence.descr: Search for occurrences of an issue by ID with optional snoozed filter
actions.searchForAnIssueOccurrence.props: The ID of the issue to search for occurrences
actions.startScan.description: Start a new scan. Optionally specify target addresses and/or tag names. If no targets or tags are provided, the scan will run on all targets.
actions.startScan.props.tag_names.descri: Tag names to filter targets. Leave empty to scan all targets.
actions.startScan.props.target_addresses: Target addresses to scan (e.g., example.com, 192.168.1.1). Leave empty to scan all targets.
auth.description: API Key for Intruder. Get it from your Intruder account.
description: Intruder is a powerful vulnerability management platform that helps businesses identify, assess, and remediate security risks across their digital assets. With its comprehensive scanning capabilities and user-friendly interface, Intruder enables organizations to stay ahead of potential threats and maintain a robust security posture.
